title: brain.response body v1
description: Brain reply. Publisher: jv-brain. Envelope conf = 1.0 in v0 (no self-assessment yet).

text.description: The reply. Empty string allowed only with finish_reason=error.

finish_reason.description: Why generation ended. 'length' = context/token limit hit; the text is truncated.

conversation_id.description: Thread this reply belongs to; mirrors the request.

in_reply_to.description: Envelope reference of the frame that triggered this reply (a brain.request or an audio.transcript final).

utterance_id.description: When the trigger was voice: the INPUT utterance this reply answers (from audio.transcript). jv-brain mints a separate say_id for the speech.say it publishes and sets that frame's in_reply_to_utterance to this value.

model.description: Model identifier that produced this reply, e.g. the GGUF name.

backend.description: Where inference ran — makes the VRAM-guard fallback (BRIEF-phase1 §5) observable on the bus.

latency_ms.description: Request-to-last-token wall time as measured by jv-brain.
